name: scrapider-capabilities
description: Optional MCP capabilities recommended by Scrapider Guidelines: Context7 library docs lookup and Codegraph code intelligence. Do not install when these servers are already registered on the host; codegraph still requires per-project `codegraph init`.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Scrapider Guidelines 推荐的可选 MCP 能力：Context7 库文档查询与 Codegraph 代码索引。宿主已注册这些服务的请勿安装；codegraph 仍需在项目内执行 codegraph init 建立索引。
